result.summary: Found 1 major issue: the bottom navigation bar's search icon is overlapped by a black horizontal line (likely a drag handle/gesture indicator), making it look broken.

issues.description: In the bottom navigation bar, a thick black horizontal line (system gesture indicator or drag handle) runs directly across/behind the search icon, visually striking through it and making the icon hard to recognize.
issues.suggestion: Move the drag-handle indicator or adjust the bottom bar padding so it does not overlap the search icon; ensure system gesture insets are respected.
